Post on the engine hatch or tank access cover, facing the person servicing the fuel sender.
Boat yards, marine service shops, builders
Fuel vapor can collect around the tank opening when the fuel sender is disturbed. A spark or other ignition source could ignite the vapor and cause a flash fire with burns.
WARNING Hull Vacuum Lift Seal Check Sign – Loss Of Seal Can Drop The Hull – 8x12 Aluminum
Loss Of Seal Can Drop The Hull
HULL VACUUM LIFT SEAL CHECK / LOSS OF SEAL CAN / DROP THE HULL / CHECK SEALS BEFORE LIFTING / KEEP CLEAR OF SUSPENDED HULL
Mount on the hull lifting frame, where it is visible to anyone approaching the suspended hull.
A vacuum lift holds the hull by suction, and a lost seal can release the load. The hull may fall from the frame and crush people beneath or beside it.
WARNING RV Awning Drive Head Sign – Spring Force Can Spin Head – 8x12 Aluminum
RV AWNING DRIVE HEAD / SPRING FORCE CAN SPIN HEAD / RESTRAIN AWNING AND CONTROL / SPRING TENSION BEFORE HEAD WORK
Fasten to the cover of the awning arm near the drive head, facing the technician opening it.
The awning spring stores force that can spin the drive head when the head is released. The turning head may strike a hand or fingers and cause bruising or fractures.
WARNING Keg Coupler Seal Removal Sign – Trapped Pressure Can Spray Liquid – 8x12 Aluminum
KEG COUPLER SEAL REMOVAL / TRAPPED PRESSURE / CAN SPRAY LIQUID / ISOLATE GAS AND VERIFY VENTED / BEFORE DISMANTLING COUPLER
Attach to the filler head or keg washer panel beside the coupler, facing the operator.
Gas pressure can stay trapped inside the keg coupler after the supply is shut off. Dismantling the coupler may spray liquid into the face or hands of the person holding it.
WARNING Lauter Rake Height Drive Sign – Rake Can Descend On You – 8x12 Aluminum
LAUTER RAKE HEIGHT DRIVE / RAKE CAN DESCEND ON YOU / LOCK OUT AND SECURE RAKE / BEFORE HEIGHT DRIVE SERVICE
Place at the top deck of the lauter tun beside the rake drive, facing the technician.
The rake hangs from its height drive and can descend under its own weight if the drive is released. A person working below or beside the rake could be struck or crushed.
WARNING Brew Filter Plate Separation Sign – Residual Pressure Can Spray Liquid – 8x12 Aluminum
BREW FILTER PLATE SEPARATION / RESIDUAL PRESSURE / CAN SPRAY LIQUID / ISOLATE AND VERIFY DEPRESSURIZED / BEFORE OPENING FILTER PACK
Post on the plate filter frame beside the plate pack, facing the operator opening it.
Pressure can remain trapped between the filter plates after the feed stops. Separating the plates may spray liquid onto the operator's face, eyes or body.
WARNING Barrel Rack Crossbar Removal Sign – Loaded Barrels Can Roll Off – 8x12 Aluminum
BARREL RACK CROSSBAR REMOVAL / LOADED BARRELS CAN ROLL OFF / EMPTY AND STABILIZE RACK / BEFORE REMOVING CROSSBARS
Mount on the barrel rack upright, facing the worker who removes the crossbars.
Loaded barrels rest against the crossbars and can roll off the rack once the bars are taken away. Rolling barrels may strike or pin a worker nearby.
WARNING Bottle Rinser Inversion Cam Sign – Cam Follower Can Crush Hands – 8x12 Aluminum
BOTTLE RINSER INVERSION CAM / CAM FOLLOWER CAN CRUSH HANDS / ISOLATE RINSER MOTION / BEFORE ADJUSTING INVERSION CAM
Fasten to the rinser frame beside the inversion cam, facing the technician adjusting it.
The cam follower travels with the rinser grippers whenever the rinser moves. Hands placed between the follower and the cam can be pinched or crushed.
WARNING Pneumatic Fruit Press Door Sign – Pressure Can Force Door Open – 8x12 Aluminum
PNEUMATIC FRUIT PRESS DOOR / PRESSURE CAN FORCE DOOR OPEN / VERIFY PRESS CYCLE ISOLATED / AND BAG PRESSURE FULLY RELEASED
Attach to the press door frame, facing the operator standing at the door.
Bag pressure left in the press or an active cycle can push the press door open with force. The door may strike the operator or crush a hand at the opening.
WARNING Spent Grain Cart Tipping Sign – Hot Grain Can Spill On You – 8x12 Aluminum
Hot Grain Can Spill On You
SPENT GRAIN CART TIPPING / HOT GRAIN CAN SPILL ON YOU / KEEP CLEAR OF CART TIP PATH / SECURE CART BEFORE DISCHARGE
Place at the post of the cart tipping station, facing workers near the discharge.
Hot spent grain pours down the tip path when the cart is tilted for discharge. A person standing in that path can be burned by the falling grain.
WARNING Fermenter Sample Cooler Sign – Hot Cleaning Fluid May Remain – 8x12 Aluminum
FERMENTER SAMPLE COOLER / HOT CLEANING FLUID MAY REMAIN / VERIFY SAMPLE LINE CLEARED / BEFORE COLLECTING A SAMPLE
Post on the fermenter sample valve panel, facing the person taking a sample.
Hot cleaning fluid can remain in the sample line and cooler after a wash cycle. Opening the valve may release it onto the hands or face of the person sampling, causing scalds.
WARNING Fin Stack Lift Fork Sign – Stack Can Drop When Fork Retracts – 8x12 Aluminum
Stack Can Drop When Fork Retracts
FIN STACK LIFT FORK / STACK CAN DROP / WHEN FORK RETRACTS / SUPPORT STACK BEFORE / RELEASING LIFT FORK RETAINERS
Mount on the press stacker frame beside the lift fork, facing the worker who handles the fork retainers.
HVAC coil makers, fin stock plants
A stack of fins rides on the lift fork and is held only while the fork stays extended. When the fork retracts or its retainers are released, the stack can drop onto hands or feet.
WARNING Helium Test Plug Retainer Sign – Pressure Can Launch Test Plug – 8x12 Aluminum
HELIUM TEST PLUG RETAINER / PRESSURE CAN LAUNCH TEST PLUG / VERIFY RETAINER IS ENGAGED / BEFORE PRESSURIZING THE CIRCUIT
Fasten to the test chamber beside the plug retainer, facing the operator before pressurizing.
HVAC and refrigeration plants, appliance makers
Test pressure pushes on the plug inside the chamber, and the retainer is what holds it in place. A plug whose retainer is not seated can launch and strike the operator.
WARNING Cabinet Foam Fixture Latch Sign – Expanding Foam Can Force Door Out – 8x12 Aluminum
Expanding Foam Can Force Door Out
CABINET FOAM FIXTURE LATCH / EXPANDING FOAM / CAN FORCE DOOR OUT / DO NOT RELEASE FIXTURE EARLY / FOLLOW THE APPROVED CURE CYCLE
Attach to the foam fixture door, facing the operator standing at the latch.
Foaming line operators, appliance plant leads
Foam expands inside the fixture during the cure cycle and presses against the door. If the latch is opened early, the door can swing out and strike the person standing in front.
WARNING Furnace Burner Test Gas Hose Sign – Damaged Hose Can Release Fuel – 8x12 Aluminum
FURNACE BURNER TEST GAS HOSE / DAMAGED HOSE CAN RELEASE FUEL / LOCK OUT TEST, ISOLATE GAS / BEFORE REPLACING TEST HOSE
Place at the burner test stand beside the gas hose, facing the technician replacing the hose.
Run test technicians, furnace plant leads
A damaged test hose can leak fuel gas into the work area around the stand. The gas may ignite from a nearby spark or hot surface and cause burns.
WARNING Appliance Glass Lift Clamp Sign – Glass Can Slip From Wrong Clamp – 8x12 Aluminum
Glass Can Slip From Wrong Clamp
APPLIANCE GLASS LIFT CLAMP / GLASS CAN SLIP FROM WRONG CLAMP / USE CLAMP RATED FOR THIS GLASS / KEEP CLEAR OF SUSPENDED PANEL
Post on the glass lifter frame near the clamp, facing the operator who selects the clamp.
A glass panel held by a clamp not rated for it can slip out of the grip while suspended. The falling panel may strike or cut people underneath.
WARNING Coil Expander Rod Retainer Sign – Rod Can Fall When Retainer Frees – 8x12 Aluminum
Rod Can Fall When Retainer Frees
COIL EXPANDER ROD RETAINER / ROD CAN FALL WHEN RETAINER FREE / SUPPORT ROD AND ISOLATE DRIVE / BEFORE RELEASING RETAINER
Mount on the expander frame next to the rod retainer, facing the technician releasing it.
HVAC coil makers, tube expansion lines
The expander rod is heavy and relies on its retainer to stay in place. When the retainer is released without support, the rod can drop and strike hands, feet or legs.
WARNING Chain Hoist Chain Bag Sign – Falling Chain Can Strike People – 8x12 Aluminum
CHAIN HOIST CHAIN BAG / FALLING CHAIN CAN STRIKE PEOPLE / SECURE BAG TO APPROVED SUPPORT / KEEP PEOPLE CLEAR BELOW HOIST
Fasten to the hoist body or trolley beside the chain bag, facing people working below.
Plants with hoists, monorails, jib cranes
A chain bag that is not tied to a proper support can let the hoist chain fall out. The falling chain may strike people standing under the hoist.
WARNING Crane Festoon Trolley Stop Sign – Trolley Can Run Off Open Track – 8x12 Aluminum
Trolley Can Run Off Open Track
CRANE FESTOON TROLLEY STOP / TROLLEY CAN RUN OFF OPEN TRACK / ISOLATE CRANE / AND SECURE TROLLEYS / BEFORE REMOVING THE END STOP
Attach to the runway end beside the festoon trolley stop, facing the person at the end stop.
The end stop keeps festoon trolleys on the runway. With the stop removed, trolleys can roll off the open track and fall onto people or equipment below.
WARNING Lifting Beam Adjustment Pin Sign – Sliding Arm Can Crush Fingers – 8x12 Aluminum
LIFTING BEAM ADJUSTMENT PIN / SLIDING ARM CAN CRUSH FINGERS / LAND AND SUPPORT BEAM / BEFORE REPOSITIONING THE PIN
Place at the body of the lifting beam beside the pin, facing the rigger who moves the pin.
The telescoping arm of the lifting beam slides when the locking pin is pulled. A finger placed in the joint can be crushed as the arm closes.
WARNING Rope Sheave Axle Removal Sign – Sheave Can Fall When Axle Frees – 8x12 Aluminum
Sheave Can Fall When Axle Frees
ROPE SHEAVE AXLE REMOVAL / SHEAVE CAN FALL WHEN AXLE FREE / UNLOAD ROPE AND SUPPORT SHEAVE / BEFORE REMOVING AXLE RETAINERS
Post on the rigging loft frame next to the sheave axle, facing the worker removing the retainers.
A heavy sheave hangs from its axle and rope load may still act on it. When the axle is freed, the sheave can fall and crush hands, feet or legs.
WARNING Crane Boom Rest Sensor Sign – Boom Can Lower On Hands – 8x12 Aluminum
CRANE BOOM REST SENSOR / BOOM CAN LOWER ON HANDS / SECURE BOOM AND ISOLATE MOTION / BEFORE ADJUSTING REST SENSOR
Mount on the boom rest, facing the technician who adjusts the sensor.
The boom rests on its support and can lower when power or hold is removed without warning. A hand under or beside the boom at the rest sensor could be crushed.
WARNING Vacuum Lifter Parking Stand Sign – Tipping Lifter Can Crush Feet – 8x12 Aluminum
VACUUM LIFTER PARKING STAND / TIPPING LIFTER CAN CRUSH FEET / SEAT LIFTER IN STABLE STAND / BEFORE RELEASING HOIST SUPPORT
Fasten to the frame of the parking stand, facing the worker who releases the hoist support.
Plants with vacuum lifters, glass shops
A lifter that is not seated squarely in its parking stand can tip when the hoist support is let go. The lifter may fall onto feet or legs and cause crush injuries.
WARNING Crane Conductor Collector Sign – Collector May Touch Live Bars – 8x12 Aluminum
CRANE CONDUCTOR COLLECTOR / COLLECTOR MAY TOUCH LIVE BARS / ISOLATE RUNWAY SUPPLY AND TEST / BEFORE REPLACING COLLECTOR SHOES
Attach to the runway end beside the conductor collector, facing the electrician replacing shoes.
Plants with crane runways, steel mills
Collector shoes ride against energized conductor bars along the runway. Touching live bars or shoes while the supply is still on during shoe replacement can cause electric shock or arc burns.
WARNING Glass Washer Roll Change Sign – Roll Can Move As Drive Releases – 8x12 Aluminum
Roll Can Move As Drive Releases
GLASS WASHER ROLL CHANGE / ROLL CAN MOVE AS DRIVE RELEASES / LOCK OUT WASHER AND SUPPORT ROLL / BEFORE REMOVING ITS BEARING
Place at the washer frame near the roll bearing, facing the mechanic who removes it.
A washer roll can shift when its drive is released or its bearing removed. A moving roll may trap or crush hands between itself and the frame.
WARNING Cement Packer Spout Seal Sign – Pressurized Powder Can Blast Eyes – 8x12 Aluminum
CEMENT PACKER SPOUT SEAL / PRESSURIZED POWDER / CAN BLAST EYES / ISOLATE FEED AND VENT SPOUT / BEFORE REPLACING SPOUT SEALS
Post on the packer spout, facing the technician replacing the spout seals.
Pressurized powder can remain in the packer spout behind the seal. Opening the seal may blast powder into the eyes and face of the person servicing it.
WARNING Kiln Car Wheel Jacking Sign – Car Can Roll Off Jack – 8x12 Aluminum
KILN CAR WHEEL JACKING / CAR CAN ROLL OFF JACK / RESTRAIN CAR AND USE SUPPORTS / BEFORE WORKING ON WHEEL
Mount on the kiln car frame, facing the worker who raises the car on a jack.
Kiln maintenance mechanics, brick plant leads
A kiln car is heavy and can roll off a jack when its wheels are serviced without restraint. The car may crush a worker's legs, feet or body.
WARNING Glass Gob Shear Blade Sign – Shear Can Close On Fingers – 8x12 Aluminum
GLASS GOB SHEAR BLADE / SHEAR CAN CLOSE ON FINGERS / ISOLATE SHEAR DRIVE / BEFORE REMOVING SHEAR BLADES
Fasten to the forming machine shear housing, facing the technician removing the blades.
The gob shear can cycle on the forming machine while its blades are exposed during removal. Fingers near the blades may be cut or severed by the closing shear.
WARNING Precast Lift Insert Recess Sign – Wrong Lift Clutch Can Drop Panel – 8x12 Aluminum
Wrong Lift Clutch Can Drop Panel
PRECAST LIFT INSERT RECESS / WRONG LIFT CLUTCH CAN DROP PANEL / USE MATCHED RATED LIFT CLUTCH / VERIFY ENGAGEMENT BEFORE LIFT
Attach to the precast form beside the lift insert recess, facing the crew rigging the panel.
A lift clutch that does not match the insert can pull out under load. The panel may fall and strike or crush people beneath it.
WARNING Wallboard Dryer Roll Drive Sign – Roll Can Catch Hands At Chain – 8x12 Aluminum
Roll Can Catch Hands At Chain
WALLBOARD DRYER ROLL DRIVE / ROLL CAN CATCH HANDS AT CHAIN / LOCK OUT SECTION DRIVE / BEFORE CHAIN TENSION ADJUSTMENT
Mount on the dryer drive guard.
The drive chain catches hands at the sprocket.
WARNING Glaze Ball Mill Charge Lid Sign – Drum Can Rotate When Unbalanced – 8x12 Aluminum
GLAZE BALL MILL CHARGE LID / DRUM CAN ROTATE WHEN UNBALANCED / LOCK OUT AND RESTRAIN DRUM / BEFORE RELEASING CHARGE LID
On the mill frame beside the charge lid hatch, at eye level where the operator stands to open the lid.
Ceramic plant maintenance supervisors and glaze room leads
Ceramic tile plants, sanitaryware plants, glaze preparation shops

With the drum rotated off dead center, the grinding media and slip shift and the drum swings by itself, catching an arm or hand at the lid opening. The charge lid is released while the drum is still free to turn.
WARNING Glass Edge Grinder Coolant Jet Sign – Broken Glass Can Strike Eyes – 8x12 Aluminum
GLASS EDGE GRINDER COOLANT JET / BROKEN GLASS CAN STRIKE EYES / KEEP SPLASH GUARD CLOSED / DO NOT REACH INTO GRINDING ZONE
On the grinder splash guard frame, at eye level beside the coolant jet nozzle.
Glass shop supervisors and edge-line operators
Flat glass fabricators, window glass shops, tempering plants

A chipped or cracked lite shatters against the grinding wheel and flings sharp fragments through coolant spray toward the face. Reaching into the grinding zone puts the hand next to the wheel as well.
WARNING Distiller Condenser Drain Sign – Hot Distillate Can Escape At Drain – 8x12 Aluminum
Hot Distillate Can Escape At Drain
DISTILLER CONDENSER DRAIN / HOT DISTILLATE CAN ESCAPE / KEEP CLEAR OF DRAIN OUTLET / FOLLOW APPROVED DRAINING METHOD
On the condenser shell directly above the drain valve, facing the person who opens the valve.
Master distillers and still house operators
Craft distilleries, spirits distilleries, extraction labs

Hot distillate left in the condenser rushes out of the drain outlet when the valve is opened and scalds anyone standing in line with it. The outlet is easy to stand in front of when working the valve handle.
WARNING Ethanol Transfer Hose Reel Sign – Hose Failure Can Release Fuel – 8x12 Aluminum
ETHANOL TRANSFER HOSE REEL / HOSE FAILURE CAN RELEASE FUEL / ISOLATE TRANSFER AND CLEAR HOSE / BEFORE REEL MAINTENANCE
On the hose reel housing next to the crank or drum guard, visible from the transfer station.
Distillery maintenance leads and tank farm operators
Spirits distilleries, bulk ethanol storage, fuel alcohol plants

A cracked or worn ethanol hose can leak or burst on the reel and spread flammable liquid near the drum and drive. Isolating and clearing the hose first keeps liquid out of the reel area during maintenance.
WARNING Rotary Evaporator Lift Sign – Glass Assembly Can Fall If Brake Released – 8x12 Aluminum
Glass Assembly Can Fall If Brake Released
ROTARY EVAPORATOR LIFT / GLASS ASSEMBLY CAN FALL / SUPPORT GLASS BEFORE / RELEASING THE LIFT BRAKE
On the evaporator lift column just below the brake release handle.
Lab managers and solvent recovery technicians
When the lift brake is released with the flask and condenser unsupported, the heavy glass assembly drops. Falling glass breaks into sharp pieces over the operator's hands and body.
WARNING Extraction Filter Screen Sign – Trapped Solvent Can Spray From Screen – 8x12 Aluminum
Trapped Solvent Can Spray From Screen
EXTRACTION FILTER SCREEN / TRAPPED SOLVENT CAN SPRAY / ISOLATE AND CLEAR THE CIRCUIT / BEFORE REMOVING FILTER SCREEN
On the filter housing door of the closed-loop extractor, at the point where the screen is pulled.
Extraction technicians and lab operations managers
Hydrocarbon extraction labs, closed-loop extraction facilities

Solvent trapped in the filter circuit can be pushed out under pressure when the screen is pulled, spraying liquid and vapor at the person removing it. Isolating and clearing the circuit first removes that supply.
WARNING Distillery Bottle Rinser Grip Sign – Gripper Can Pin Hands At Guide – 8x12 Aluminum
Gripper Can Pin Hands At Guide
DISTILLERY BOTTLE RINSER GRIP / GRIPPER CAN PIN HANDS TO GUIDE / ISOLATE RINSER BEFORE / REMOVING BROKEN BOTTLES
On the rinser guard rail beside the gripper station, where broken bottles are cleared.
Bottling line mechanics and packaging supervisors
Distilleries, bottling halls, spirits packaging lines
Rinser grippers close on bottles and guides and can trap a hand reaching in to remove a broken bottle. Moving parts can start while the line is still live.
WARNING Biomass Basket Draining Sign – Hot Liquid Can Drain From Basket – 8x12 Aluminum
Hot Liquid Can Drain From Basket
BIOMASS BASKET DRAINING / HOT LIQUID CAN DRAIN FROM BASKET / KEEP CLEAR OF DRIPPING LOAD / LAND BASKET BEFORE HANDLING
On the still frame beside the hoist and basket landing area.
Distillation operators and essential oil plant managers
Essential oil distilleries, botanical extraction plants
A basket lifted out of a steam distillation still still drips hot water and oil from the biomass. Reaching under or handling the load while it drains scalds the hands and arms.
WARNING Spirits Tank Gauge Glass Sign – Broken Glass Can Release Spirits – 8x12 Aluminum
SPIRITS TANK GAUGE GLASS / BROKEN GLASS CAN RELEASE FUEL / ISOLATE AND CLEAR GAUGE CIRCUIT / BEFORE REPLACING THE TUBE
On the tank gauge glass guard, at the valves where the tube is isolated.
Tank farm operators and distillery maintenance techs
Spirits distilleries, bulk ethanol storage, fuel alcohol plants
A broken gauge tube lets stored spirits or ethanol run out the gauge connection and flood the work area with flammable liquid. The circuit must be isolated and cleared before the tube is replaced.
WARNING Still Agitator Seal Removal Sign – Hot Charge Can Leak Through Seal – 8x12 Aluminum
Hot Charge Can Leak Through Seal
STILL AGITATOR SEAL REMOVAL / HOT CHARGE CAN LEAK THROUGH SEAL / ISOLATE DRIVE AND EMPTY VESSEL / VERIFY COOL BEFORE SEAL WORK
On the still agitator drive housing near the seal gland, where the mechanical seal is accessed.
Distilleries, extraction plants, essential oil facilities
With product still in the vessel, a removed seal opens a path for hot charge to run down the shaft onto the worker. Drive isolation prevents the shaft from turning while the seal is out.
WARNING Soap Cutter Wire Frame Sign – Tensioned Wires Can Snap Back – 8x12 Aluminum
SOAP CUTTER WIRE FRAME / TENSIONED WIRES CAN SNAP BACK / LOCK OUT CUTTER AND CONTROL / WIRE TENSION BEFORE FRAME WORK
On the cutter frame at the wire tensioning point, facing the person adjusting the frame.
Soap plant maintenance leads and operators
Soap manufacturing plants, detergent plants, personal care plants

Cutting wires are held under tension in the frame, and a released or broken wire whips back into the hands and face. The cutter and wire tension must be locked out and controlled before the frame is touched.
WARNING Paint Pail Lid Crimper Sign – Crimp Head Can Crush Fingers – 8x12 Aluminum
PAINT PAIL LID CRIMPER / CRIMP HEAD CAN CRUSH FINGERS / KEEP HANDS OUT OF LID RIM / ISOLATE BEFORE JAM CLEARING
On the crimper guard door beside the lid rim loading position.
Paint line operators and filling room supervisors
Paint plants, coatings fill lines, chemical packaging plants
The crimp head closes on the rim and lid with enough force to crush fingers placed there to seat a lid. Clearing a jam without isolating the crimper leaves the head free to cycle.
WARNING Candle Dipping Carriage Sign – Moving Carriage Can Pin You – 8x12 Aluminum
CANDLE DIPPING CARRIAGE / MOVING CARRIAGE CAN PIN YOU / KEEP OUT OF CARRIAGE TRAVEL / LOCK OUT BEFORE WICK RACK WORK
On the dipping line frame beside the carriage rail, where the wick rack is loaded.
Candle plant operators and maintenance supervisors
Candle makers, wax plants, specialty manufacturing plants
The dipping carriage travels along its rail and can squeeze a person between the carriage and the frame. Wick rack work needs the carriage locked out so it cannot move.
WARNING Pet Food Coater Vacuum Lid Sign – Heavy Lid Can Fall On You – 8x12 Aluminum
Heavy Lid Can Fall On You
PET FOOD COATER VACUUM LID / HEAVY LID CAN FALL ON YOU / SECURE LID WITH APPROVED PROP / BEFORE WORK BELOW OPEN LID
On the coater vacuum drum frame, next to the lid hinge and the prop storage point.
Pet food plants, kibble coating lines, feed mills
The raised vacuum lid is heavy and can drop if its lifting system fails while someone is working under it. An approved prop holds it up when work is needed below.
WARNING Cosmetic Pan Ejector Sign – Ejector Can Pin Fingers To Die – 8x12 Aluminum
Ejector Can Pin Fingers To Die
COSMETIC PAN EJECTOR / EJECTOR CAN PIN FINGERS TO DIE / LOCK OUT PRESS AND EJECTOR / BEFORE CLEARING STUCK PANS
On the press housing beside the pan die and ejector, at the operator's reach height.
Cosmetic line operators and press technicians
Cosmetic fill plants, pressed powder lines, personal care manufacturers
The ejector pushes pans out of the die and can close on fingers pulling a stuck pan. Locking out the press and ejector keeps the ram from cycling during the jam clear.
WARNING Adhesive Pump Follower Plate Sign – Lowering Plate Can Trap Hands – 8x12 Aluminum
ADHESIVE PUMP FOLLOWER PLATE / LOWERING PLATE CAN TRAP HANDS / KEEP HANDS OUT OF DRUM RIM / WHILE FOLLOWER PLATE DESCENDS
On the drum unloader column beside the drum rim and plate, within sight of the person changing drums.
Adhesive plant operators and filling line leads
Adhesive and sealant plants, hot melt lines, chemical packaging
The follower plate descends into the drum rim and can trap a hand placed on the rim while the plate lowers. The gap closes quickly against a heavy plate.
WARNING Warp Beam Bearing Cap Sign – Heavy Beam Can Fall From Frame – 8x12 Aluminum
Heavy Beam Can Fall From Frame
WARP BEAM BEARING CAP / HEAVY BEAM CAN FALL FROM FRAME / SUPPORT BEAM BEFORE / RELEASING THE BEARING CAPS
On the warper frame beside the bearing caps that hold the beam journals.
Weaving mills, warp preparation rooms, knitting plants
Once the bearing caps are released the heavy warp beam is held only by its support, and it can drop out of the frame onto hands and feet. The beam should be supported before any cap is loosened.
WARNING Needle Loom Stripper Plate Sign – Needles Can Puncture Hands – 8x12 Aluminum
NEEDLE LOOM STRIPPER PLATE / NEEDLES CAN PUNCTURE HANDS / LOCK OUT NEEDLE DRIVE / BEFORE ADJUSTING STRIPPER PLATE
On the needle loom head guard, beside the stripper plate adjustment point.
Needlepunch nonwoven plants, geotextile plants, felt producers
Barbed needles sit just behind the stripper plate and can stab or tear a hand reaching in to adjust it. The needle drive must be locked out because the board can cycle without warning.
WARNING Tenter Clip Chain Service Sign – Chain Can Catch Hands At Return – 8x12 Aluminum
Chain Can Catch Hands At Return
TENTER CLIP CHAIN SERVICE / CHAIN CAN CATCH HANDS AT RETURN / LOCK OUT CHAIN DRIVE / BEFORE REPLACING TENTER CLIPS
On the tenter frame side rail near the chain return sprocket, where clips are changed.
Textile finishing plants, dye and finishing houses
The chain and clips run toward a return sprocket and can catch a hand and draw it in. The chain drive must be locked out before anyone replaces clips.
WARNING Laundry Sling Rail Switch Sign – Misaligned Switch Can Drop Load – 8x12 Aluminum
LAUNDRY SLING RAIL SWITCH / MISALIGNED SWITCH CAN DROP LOAD / VERIFY TRACK SWITCH LOCKED / BEFORE MOVING A LOADED SLING
On the rail support column beside the switch, visible to the person moving slings.
Laundry plant managers and sort floor leads
Industrial laundries, linen plants, healthcare laundries
If the track switch is not fully locked, a loaded sling can run off the rail gap and fall to the floor. The switch lock should be confirmed before any loaded sling is moved.
WARNING Garment Press Head Cylinder Sign – Head Can Fall When Pin Releases – 8x12 Aluminum
Head Can Fall When Pin Releases
GARMENT PRESS HEAD CYLINDER / HEAD CAN FALL WHEN PIN RELEASES / LOCK OUT AND SUPPORT PRESS HEAD / BEFORE CYLINDER PIN REMOVAL
On the press column beside the head cylinder pin and clevis.
Garment finishing plants, uniform laundries, dry cleaners
The press head is carried on the cylinder pin, and when the pin is pulled the head drops. Locking out and supporting the head stops it falling on hands and arms.
WARNING Dye Beam Lift Mandrel Sign – Loaded Beam Can Slide Off Mandrel – 8x12 Aluminum
Loaded Beam Can Slide Off Mandrel
DYE BEAM LIFT MANDREL / LOADED BEAM CAN SLIDE OFF / ENGAGE END RETAINERS / BEFORE LIFTING THE DYE BEAM
On the beam lift stand next to the mandrel, where the operator loads the beam.
Dyehouses, textile dye plants, warp prep rooms
A loaded dye beam can slide off the mandrel if the end retainers are not engaged when it is raised. The beam falls across the feet and legs of anyone nearby.
WARNING Fabric Batch Roll Shaft Sign – Roll Can Fall As Shaft Withdraws – 8x12 Aluminum
Roll Can Fall As Shaft Withdraws
FABRIC BATCH ROLL SHAFT / ROLL CAN FALL AS SHAFT WITHDRAWS / SUPPORT ROLL ON RATED CRADLE / BEFORE WITHDRAWING SHAFT
On the batching stand beside the shaft end and cradle, where the roll is released.
Fabric inspection leads and calender operators
Textile finishing plants, fabric inspection rooms, calendering lines
Pulling the shaft out of a heavy cloth roll can let the roll drop if it is not carried by a rated cradle. The roll crushes feet and legs on impact.
WARNING Shop Towel Dryer Cool Down Sign – Hot Oily Load Can Ignite – 8x12 Aluminum
SHOP TOWEL DRYER COOL DOWN / HOT OILY LOAD CAN IGNITE / DO NOT BYPASS COOL DOWN CYCLE / FOLLOW APPROVED LOAD PROCEDURE
On the dryer door frame, at eye level beside the cool down controls.
Laundry plant managers and dryer operators
Shop towel laundries, mat and mop plants, industrial laundries

WARNING Lab Freezer CO2 Backup Sign – Released CO2 Can Displace Air – 8x12 Aluminum
LAB FREEZER CO2 BACKUP / RELEASED CO2 CAN DISPLACE AIR / LEAVE ON ATMOSPHERE ALARM / AUTHORIZED SERVICE ONLY
On the freezer room wall beside the CO2 backup cylinder manifold.
Lab safety officers and facilities managers

A discharge of backup CO2 into a closed room pushes out breathable air, and people can become weak or unconscious without noticing. Leaving at the atmosphere alarm and keeping service to authorized people limits exposure.
WARNING Glass Reactor Clamp Release Sign – Heavy Glass Can Drop Or Break – 8x12 Aluminum
Heavy Glass Can Drop Or Break
GLASS REACTOR CLAMP RELEASE / HEAVY GLASS CAN DROP OR BREAK / SUPPORT GLASS ASSEMBLY / BEFORE RELEASING SUPPORT CLAMPS
On the reactor support frame beside the flange clamps, within reach of the person releasing them.
Pharmaceutical labs, fine chemical labs, synthesis suites

WARNING Tablet Press Feed Frame Lift Sign – Frame Can Fall During Removal – 8x12 Aluminum

On the press door frame next to the feed frame lift points.
Solid dose plant technicians and maintenance leads
Tablet manufacturing plants, pharmaceutical compression suites
